summary: All 6,000 Opus High discovery tasks are complete. This creation-only search did not find construction pools that satisfy the two benchmark designs. The campaign stopped at the feasibility gate; neither VP-Bench nor VP-Bench-Hard was created. Calibration, Astra screening and final evaluations were not submitted.
important_limits: No headline xHigh/16384 calibration was run, so these are not benchmark scores for either requested suite.
No Astra inference was submitted because discovery could not supply both tiers.
The supply bounds apply only to the recorded predicate search and optimistic candidate space; they do not prove that every creation benchmark is impossible.
Small lexical weaknesses are real leads, but enlarging their paradigms does not satisfy the frozen family and tense-diversity requirements.
next_design_question: A follow-on design would need a broader construction space or a revised diversity/size policy. Prefixes, sanadi and trace-based tasks were explicitly deferred in this campaign; none was silently added.
